def _read_expanded(path, stack):
    """Return the lines of ``path`` with ``@include`` directives expanded."""
    real = os.path.realpath(path)
    if real in stack:
        raise ConfigError("include cycle detected: {}".format(path))
    stack = stack + (real,)
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        lines = fh.read().splitlines()
    base = os.path.dirname(real)
    out = []
    for raw in lines:
        parts = raw.split(None, 1)
        if not parts or parts[0] != "@include":
            out.append(raw)
            continue
        target = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        if not target:
            raise ConfigError("{}: @include requires a path".format(path))
        target = os.path.join(base, target)
        if not os.path.isfile(target):
            raise ConfigError("{}: include file not found: {}".format(path, target))
        try:
            out.extend(_read_expanded(target, stack))
        except OSError as exc:
            raise ConfigError("cannot read include {}: {}".format(target, exc))
    return out
''')
